pages.title: Learning Materials
pages.text: Under Knowledge Level, add a book, manuscript, or bottle o' enchanting and select Learn. Manuscripts teach more than books; bottles teach a little more than manuscripts.

pages.title: Knowledge Level One
pages.text: Knowledge begins at level zero. At 300 accumulated knowledge XP, it automatically reaches $(bold)level one$(); no enchanted book is needed.$(br2)Give the dragon a name and wait for growth stage three, and it can attempt its $(l:dragonmaid:forms/transformation)first transformation$(/l).

pages.title: Knowledge Level Two
pages.text: Level two needs 1,000 knowledge and one non-cursed enchanted task book. Read the book in a lower slot whenever you are ready; its progress is saved.$(br2)When both are ready, advance to open the second accessory slot. Knowledge is not spent.

pages.title: Enchanted Books
pages.text: At knowledge level one, non-cursed enchanted books can be placed in the learning slot. At level two, cursed books can be read too. More enchantments and higher levels usually bring more knowledge.$(br2)Learning and advancement use separate slots. Knowledge beyond the next goal is kept.

pages.title: Using Wooden Doors
pages.text: At knowledge level two, a human-form companion can open and close wooden doors. If one leaf is too narrow and there is room, it can open both.$(br2)Leave room for its height and width; if it cannot fit, it will try another route.

pages.title: Knowledge Level Three
pages.text: After level two, reach 2,500 knowledge and read two non-cursed task books and one cursed task book. Read them together or one at a time.$(br2)Advancing to level three opens the third accessory slot; knowledge is retained.

pages.title: Choosing Task Books
pages.text: Non-cursed books need enchantments and no curse. Cursed books go in the cursed slot; normal books do not count.$(br2)Any valid enchantment or level works; books can be identical. Each book counts once, even with several enchantments. Effects do not transfer.

pages.title: Progression and Limits
pages.text: Reach 1,000 knowledge for level two, then 2,500 for level three. You can advance only one level at a time, so prepare the books for each step in order.$(br2)Level three is the current limit. The new slots let you adjust your $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/companions)accessory combination$(/l).

pages.title: Knowledge and Growth
pages.text: Knowledge levels two and three do not require growth stages four or five. The $(l:dragonmaid:forms/transformation)first transformation$(/l) still needs a name, stage three, and knowledge level one (300 total XP).$(br2)Starting at level one, each level opens another row in $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/companions)your companion’s pack$(/l).

pages.title: Tending the Flame
pages.text: At knowledge level two or higher, an ice dragon that sees you catch fire can cool you with a harmless puff of frost. Fire dragons of level two or higher favour their usual breath when a hydra is not burning, and their flames linger to hinder its regrowth.

pages.title: A Little Further
pages.text: At knowledge level three, a nearby fire dragon can grant you fire resistance when you catch fire or enter the Nether. An ice dragon lends you water breathing when you dip your head underwater. Stray from your companion and the protection soon wears off.

pages.title: A Chapter at a Time
pages.text: Each batch pauses at the next XP goal, keeping the last item's extra XP and leaving unused materials in the slot. Click Learn again after 300 or 1,000 to continue.$(br2)At or above 2,500, extra XP from the last item is still kept, but further learning stops.

pages.title: Lessons Remembered
pages.text: Read task books in the lower slots to consume them and save progress. Changing form or travelling in a horn does not erase it. These books give no XP.$(br2)Learn becomes Advance when this batch can meet the XP goal and the task books are ready. Removing materials updates the button.
